items.heading: Searches on This Topic Sound
items.text: Searches on this topic sound like "can PCM students do B.Pharm", "can I become a doctor without biology" and "is BSc Agriculture possible with PCM". The honest answer to each is "it depends on the line in one notice". This guide reads that line for you.

items.heading: Read the Status Column First
items.text: Read the status column first. "Needs Biology" means no route exists without it, "Maths or Biology" means either subject can carry you, and "No Biology needed" means the notice does not mention it.

items.heading: Pharmacy Is the Course Students
items.text: Pharmacy is the course students most often get wrong, because the national rule and the state rule differ in wording. Here is what each one says in 2026.

NEET eligibility names Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Biotechnology and English. An NMC public notice of 22 November 2023 allows these to be studied as additional subjects after Class 12 from a recognised board.
NMC notice via Medical Dialogues, The Federal, Business Standard
State seats are ranked on the BiPC stream of EAPCET in Telangana (PVNRTVU note). The 15 percent national quota is filled on NEET UG ranks.
Telangana and Andhra Pradesh 2026-27 notices ask for 45 percent in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English (40 percent for reserved categories).
KNRUHS and Dr NTR UHS notifications
Admission on Class 12 PCB marks, 50 percent (40 percent for reserved categories), with NEET deferred to 2027-28.
NCAHP deferral reported by Medical Dialogues

items.heading: Read the Line, Not
items.text: Read the line, not the headline. Open the notice for each course and find the Class 12 subject line yourself. Four of the fifteen doors in the audit change by state or college.

items.heading: Price the Extra
items.text: Price the extra-subject route fully. Fees can be Rs 1,220. A coaching year can reach Rs 3 lakh. Ask your child whether they want medicine itself, or the status around it.

items.heading: Look At Vacant Seats Before
items.text: Look at vacant seats before you pay. A seat that is easy to get is not a reason to pay a high fee. Maharashtra pharmacy had 15,927 empty seats in 2025-26.

items.heading: Check the Quota and Local
items.text: Check the quota and local-status papers. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana reserve most state seats for local candidates, and papers take time to arrange.
